description.value: The Old City Station Pub is a downtown Nanaimo sports bar that has held the title of the city's top sports bar every year since 2008. The pub is known for its chicken wings, a broad selection of Vancouver Island craft beers, and a busy live events calendar featuring comedy nights and rock bands. A cyclist rolling into the heart of downtown Nanaimo will find a lively, full-service pub with table reservations available and a co-located private events venue next door.
